serviceName: Website address with its bare domain
description: Points www at a website hosted by Connect Your Domains and the bare domain (example.com) at Connect Your Domains's redirect, which sends visitors on to https://www.example.com; with a TXT record proving the domain's owner chose it. Applied with no host. Three records; never touches MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC or any other record.
variableDescription: %token%: a random per-hostname ownership token, 32 lowercase letters and digits. %apexip%: the IPv4 address of Connect Your Domains's bare-domain redirect, one fixed address; a bare variable because an A record's value is an address and cannot carry a prefix.
